method: Uninstrumented physical-board host elapsed command times; identical clean FP29 kernel/disks, fresh matching pack nonces per phase. Source upload excluded; all command, system work and save pauses included. Full suite is the sum of four independent phases; no guessed real PDP-11/70 time.
unix_suite_version: V2: unchanged build, IPC and text phases; corrected read phase lists /usr/lib and recursively walks the installed /usr. Original V1 retained separately with its missing-/usr/bin warning.
profile_method: Timer IRQ sampling every 997 us on core 0, enabled only during timed guest commands in original read phase. 64-byte PC buckets, symbol attribution approximate; native PCs include memory-load stalls. CPU category means guest not executing WAIT, not an exact breakdown of every native CPU cycle. Instrumented times excluded from performance results. Baseline Feather and post-candidate Plus 2 profiles are not a matched before/after timing experiment.
excluded_trials: Private builds that accidentally used a different local compiler default and incomplete captures were discarded. All accepted final measured programs equal the explicit canonical-compiler release programs by SHA-256.
